description: Upfirst helps small businesses inspect and manage their AI phone receptionists from ChatGPT. Users can review account setup, agents, skills, knowledge, custom actions, and call history, then update receptionist settings, training material, SMS and transfer skills, and custom action configuration within their connected Upfirst organization.

defaultPrompt: Summarize last week's calls and flag the ones worth following up on.
Find questions my receptionist couldn't answer last week and add those answers to its knowledge.
Set up my receptionist to text callers our address when they ask where we are.
